WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price,
    AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS byte_rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
cross_media_type_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_byte_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(m.average_unit_price) AS average_unit_price,
  AVG(m.byte_rate) AS average_byte_rate,
  AVG(m.byte_rate - c.average_byte_rate) AS average_rate_excess
FROM media_type_rates AS m
CROSS JOIN cross_media_type_average AS c
WHERE m.byte_rate > c.average_byte_rate;
